_source: 848 Lichess studies (most-liked list + searches), pulled 2026-11-09. Moves and positions only; authors' text not exported (licensed to Lichess, not us).
_traps_method: victim move = the line's biggest engine drop for the side that played it (Stockfish depth 10); engine_verified = drop >= 200 cp and the punishing side still >= +200 at the end; at_our_level = how often players rated 1100-1800 (3.49M Lichess games, Oct 2026, blitz+rapid) reach the position and play the victim move; real = >= 30 games at the position and >= 5% play it
